prio-1037.packet:
group_J: the army, now Stouts, Shellshockers and Blitzes. A party of three or more of his at our extractors, constructors or home is its business first. Otherwise it gathers at spot_47 and holds there, taking in the new Stouts (armstump) and Shellshockers (armart) from the plants; from spot_47 it fights any party of his that comes within reach of spot_47, spot_56, spot_59, spot_38 or spot_39 when we outweigh it, and when strike_two is given it advances by spot_49, then spot_40, then spot_27, killing his extractors and light turrets. Against Centurions (armwar) and Rocketeers (armrock) the Stouts lead and the Blitzes come in beside them, never alone ahead. Against a party that outweighs it, it walks to spot_63 and holds there. It never walks into the Beamer's reach at G2.

Every Stout and Shellshocker group and group_X joins group_J. group_V and group_W join group_O when their quarry is dead or gone.

group_O: the home guard, the Blitzes at home. It kills Pawns (armpw), Ticks (armflea) and Lazarus (armrectr) at our extractors and constructors (spot_67, spot_74, spot_73, spot_68, spot_62, spot_69, spot_61, spot_63, spot_54, spot_64, spot_76, spot_50, spot_52, spot_45, spot_43, spot_71, spot_66, spot_59, spot_56, spot_47, spot_36, spot_28, spot_38, spot_39, spot_78, spot_58), sending one or two of its soldiers at a lone Tick or Pawn, otherwise it stands at spot_63. Against a party that outweighs it, it walks to home. It never goes past spot_66, spot_47 or spot_36.

Rovers (armfav): every group of armfav, group_A and group_L among them, roves (rove): being seen is its job; leave it to rove.

Constructors: when Pawns of his stand within reach, they walk to spot_63 and wait. Otherwise: first a light turret (armllt) beside every extractor of ours that has none (spot_45, spot_50, spot_71, spot_63, spot_59, spot_56, spot_38, spot_47); then free metal spots in this order: spot_56, spot_47, spot_39, spot_28, spot_66, spot_78, spot_30, spot_19, spot_22, spot_33, spot_44, spot_58, spot_49, a light turret beside each right after its extractor; a lost extractor or turret is rebuilt as soon as the raider is gone. One construction turret (armnanotc) beside each plant. Energy: with the energy line reading STALLING, one solar (armsolar) at home; with energy banking or the store full, no solar and no advanced solar, ever. A constructor standing in a plant's exit lane walks out of it at once; they never build or wait in a plant's exit lane.

Commander: works at home on its list and helps the plants from beside them, never standing in a plant's exit lane. It attacks and D-guns raiders at our home extractors and constructors; it never goes past spot_69 or spot_54.

Plants: make their lists in order.

group_J: the army, Stouts (armstump) and Shellshockers (armart), as one body; it sends no detachments. It never turns aside for a lone Tick (armflea), Pawn (armpw), Rocketeer (armrock), constructor (armck) or Lazarus (armrectr) away from its way: the Rovers deal with those. His army is broken; its job now is his base. It has passed spot_35 and spot_29. Its way, advancing and fighting what stands on it: spot_18, then spot_16, then his_lab, then spot_10, then spot_6, killing his commander, extractors, light turrets and the Bot Lab; it never goes back to a stop it has reached. His commander (armcom) in sight is attacked by the whole group at once. At his_lab the Shellshockers shell the Beamer (armbeamer) from beyond its reach first, then the whole group kills his Bot Lab (armlab) and everything near it. Only if a party of his outweighs the whole group: it walks to spot_40 and holds there.

Every Stout and Shellshocker group joins group_J.

apexv024.packet:
Plan: group_H, our army of about 13,800, walks east now into his G5-H5 yard as one body and kills his soldiers, his commander (armcom) and his Bot Lab (armlab at his_lab, H5); his army seen is about 3,200. Pawns (armpw) raiding our extractors in C6-C7 (spot_134, spot_129, spot_122) are group_Y's alone.

group_H is our army. Its standoff from the Pawns in C6-C7 is over: the Pawns are never its business. It walks east now: its way is spot_93, then spot_98, then spot_85, then his_lab, then spot_100, spot_94 and spot_104, fighting (fight to) as one body, Stouts in front, Whistlers (armsam) behind them shooting Sentries from their 550 reach. It never goes back to a place it has reached, never goes back to rally_e2 or rally_east, and never goes home. It sends no detachments and never chases a Tick (armflea), Pawn (armpw), constructor (armck) or Lazarus (armrectr). An enemy party with Maces (armham), Centurions (armwar) or Rocketeers (armrock) in sight within 1,000 of it: the whole group attacks it and kills it, then goes on along its way. His commander (armcom) in sight: the whole group attacks it and keeps attacking until it is dead. It kills his Sentries, construction turrets, converters, solars, extractors, constructors and the lab on its way. Only from a party that outweighs it does it walk back to spot_93.

group_Y is the home guard (Rovers and Blitzes). Enemy Pawns (armpw), Ticks (armflea), Blitzes (armflash) or Maces (armham) at our extractors, generators or constructors on our half (spot_129, spot_134, spot_128, spot_122, spot_146, spot_152, spot_111, spot_114, spot_108, spot_110, spot_103, spot_95, spot_101, spot_83, spot_71, spot_69, spot_81, spot_86, spot_89, spot_60, spot_56, spot_57, spot_55, spot_58, spot_78, home, spot_109, spot_118, spot_119, spot_120, spot_124, spot_133, spot_138, spot_142, spot_143, spot_144, spot_145, spot_87, spot_91, spot_90, spot_82, spot_80, spot_67, spot_43, spot_49, spot_52, spot_53, spot_36, spot_40, spot_106): the whole of group_Y attacks that party and chases it until it is dead or off our half, then walks back to spot_103 and stands there. It never joins group_H and never goes east of spot_101. New Rovers and Blitzes from plant_3993 join group_Y.

New Stouts and Whistlers from the plants (and lone Stouts at home): they walk to rally_e2 (E5), and from there they join group_H wherever it is, six or more together.

group_A (Rovers, one Blitz): it roves; leave it to rove.

Commander: helps the plants and the advanced vehicle plant at home, and the fusion at home. Works only at home and on the spots near home (spot_96, spot_99, spot_102, spot_109, spot_87, spot_78); never walks east of spot_103. An enemy Tick or Pawn or small raid party within reach at home: it attacks it and uses the D-gun.

Constructors (armcv): they work their lists. When a list is done, the ones at home help build the fusion (armfus) at home until it stands; the others take free metal spots, each the first one still free that no other constructor is going to: spot_129, spot_96, spot_147, spot_76, spot_155, spot_77, spot_62, spot_41, spot_28, spot_32, spot_37, spot_38. Beside every extractor away from home they build a light turret (armllt) right after it. With the energy line reading STALLING: an advanced solar (armadvsol) at home; banking: no generator. An enemy party near the spot they work: they step away toward home and come back when it is gone. They never build in front of a plant's exit.

The plants: what their lists say.

jev114.packet:
Our body attacks his economy by the south route, away from his turret posts at spot_27, spot_16 and spot_40.

Raids at home come first, for the home guard: an armpw, armflea or a lone armham at our extractors or constructors on our side (spot_74, spot_73, spot_67, spot_68, spot_69, spot_76, spot_43, spot_45, spot_52, spot_39, spot_38) is attacked by group_T1, group_A1 or group_C1 until it is dead or gone.

group_H1, the body: its next stop is spot_55, where the whole body gathers. Then, in order, never going back to a place it has reached: spot_57, spot_42, spot_35, spot_34, spot_29. His armck constructors within its reach it kills on the way. A lone armpw, armham or armflea is never its business, and it never chases one toward his turrets. A party of three or more of his in its way that it outweighs it kills whole, then goes on. At each spot it kills his armck constructors first, then soldiers, extractors and solars; it never walks onto spot_27, spot_16 or spot_40. It attacks his commander only with the whole body together. It never sends detachments. Only from a party that outweighs it does it walk back, to spot_49.

group_V1 and every new group from the plants: they follow group_H1's way (spot_49, spot_55, spot_57, spot_42, spot_35, spot_34, spot_29) and join group_H1; they never go alone past group_H1.

group_T1, group_A1, group_C1: home guard. group_T1 stands at spot_52 and kills raiders on our strip; group_A1 and group_C1 stand at spot_73. From a party that outweighs them they walk to home.

Commander: besides the raids, it works at home and spot_73, spot_74, spot_68, spot_69 and never goes east of spot_69.

Constructors: constructor_26470 and constructor_18073 take apart the wreck fields at D5, E5 and E4 (thousands of metal) whenever no enemy is near them, then come back to expansion. The others take free metal spots, in this order as they are free: spot_73, spot_45, spot_39, spot_47, spot_49, spot_28, spot_30. Every extractor away from home gets a light turret (armllt) beside it right after it. With the energy line reading STALLING and metal above 300: one armadvsol at home; with energy full: an armmakr at home. From enemy soldiers they walk to home.

Rover groups (armfav): rove. Leave them to rove.

rovemove.packet:
We start at home (B8), south-west. He is Cortex, likely around G4-H5 in the east.

Commander: follows its list. When the list ends it helps the plant and builds extractors at spot_73, spot_68, spot_69, spot_62 when free. It stays at home and near spot_69; it never walks toward his half. Against raiders (corfav, corak, corgator) at our home buildings it fights them with its D-gun. Against a party that outweighs it, it walks home beside the plant.

Constructors: their job is taking free extractor spots, in this order: spot_73, spot_68, spot_69, spot_62, spot_76, spot_63, spot_61, spot_64, spot_71, spot_54, spot_59, spot_52, spot_50, spot_45, spot_43, spot_66, spot_78, spot_56, spot_47. A light turret armllt beside each of spot_64, spot_71, spot_59, spot_52, spot_66, spot_78, spot_56, spot_47, spot_43 right after its extractor. With the energy line reading STALLING and metal above 150: a solar; otherwise no solar. Against an enemy party nearby, a constructor walks home.

Plant: makes its list in order; after the counted entries, armflash mostly, one armcv whenever we have fewer than five constructors.

Rover groups (armfav): they rove, from the first Rover: to his side, looking for and killing his constructors and extractors. Being seen is their job.

Blitz groups (armflash): the first group of Blitzes stands at spot_64, covering our east extractors. It kills any corfav, corak or corgator raiding our extractors: one or two Blitzes are sent against a lone raider, the whole group against a party of three or more at our buildings, then it returns to spot_64. Against a party that outweighs it, it walks home.
